newsHighlights.title: Chinese star Lang Ping gets volleyball's highest honor
newsHighlights.summary: China's volleyball legend Lang Ping was awarded the Volleyball Order on Saturday and dedicated the honor to those who helped mold her remarkable career.
newsHighlights.translation: 中国排球传奇郎平周六荣获排球运动最高荣誉“排球勋章”，她将这份荣誉献给了那些帮助塑造她非凡职业生涯的人。

newsHighlights.title: NVIDIA board reinstates Jensen Huang as president, CEO and board director
newsHighlights.summary: US chipmaker NVIDIA announced that Jensen Huang has been reinstated as the company's president and chief executive officer, as well as a member of its board of directors.
newsHighlights.translation: 美国芯片制造商英伟达宣布，黄仁勋已被重新任命为公司总裁兼首席执行官，并重新进入董事会。

newsHighlights.title: From fading mining town to Xinjiang ski destination
newsHighlights.summary: A fading mining town in Xinjiang has been transformed into a popular ski destination, offering a new path of growth for local communities.
newsHighlights.translation: 新疆一座日渐衰落的矿业小镇转型为热门滑雪目的地，为当地社区开辟了新的成长之路。

newsHighlights.title: Xi Story: Bringing Hainan's rainforest back to life
newsHighlights.summary: Years of patient ecological restoration have brought Hainan's tropical rainforest back to life, showing how long-term effort can reverse environmental damage.
newsHighlights.translation: 经过多年耐心的生态修复，海南热带雨林重焕生机，展现了长期努力如何扭转环境破坏。

newsHighlights.title: Xi's APEC speech inspires optimism for new chapter in Asia-Pacific prosperity
newsHighlights.summary: Xi's APEC speech has inspired optimism about a new chapter in Asia-Pacific prosperity, highlighting openness, cooperation and shared development.
newsHighlights.translation: 习近平的APEC讲话激发了人们对亚太繁荣新篇章的乐观期待，强调开放、合作与共同发展。

quote.quote: Education is the most powerful weapon which you can use to change the world.
quote.author: Nelson Mandela
quote.translation: 教育是你能用来改变世界的最强大武器。
quote.explanation: 曼德拉强调教育具有改变个人命运与社会现实的力量。正如郎平把荣誉归于一路教导她的人，真正的成长离不开学习、引导与坚持。

vocabulary.definition: 使复职；恢复（原有职位或状态）
vocabulary.example: The board voted to reinstate Jensen Huang as president and CEO.
vocabulary.translation: 董事会投票决定让黄仁勋重新担任总裁兼首席执行官。
vocabulary.newsContext: 来自标题“NVIDIA board reinstates Jensen Huang as president, CEO and board director”。

vocabulary.example: China's resilience exposes the limits of short-term pressure tactics.
vocabulary.translation: 中国的韧性暴露出短期施压策略的局限。
vocabulary.newsContext: 来自新闻“China's resilience exposes limits of US tariff policy”。

vocabulary.definition: 把（荣誉、成就等）归于；致力于，献身于
vocabulary.example: Lang Ping dedicated the honor to those who helped mold her career.
vocabulary.translation: 郎平把这份荣誉献给了那些帮助塑造她职业生涯的人。
vocabulary.newsContext: 来自新闻“Lang Ping dedicated the honor to those who helped mold her remarkable career”。

vocabulary.example: Great teachers help mold a student's character and habits.
vocabulary.translation: 优秀的老师帮助塑造学生的品格与习惯。
vocabulary.newsContext: 来自新闻“those who helped mold her remarkable career”。

vocabulary.definition: 非凡的；显著的；值得注意的
vocabulary.example: She built a remarkable career through decades of hard work.
vocabulary.translation: 她凭借数十年的努力成就了非凡的职业生涯。
vocabulary.newsContext: 来自新闻“her remarkable career as congratulatory messages poured in”。

vocabulary.example: The transformation from a fading mining town to a ski destination took years.
vocabulary.translation: 从衰落的矿业小镇转型为滑雪胜地花费了数年时间。
vocabulary.newsContext: 来自新闻“From fading mining town to Xinjiang ski destination”。

vocabulary.example: Efforts to restore Hainan's rainforest have shown real results.
vocabulary.translation: 修复海南雨林的努力已初见成效。
vocabulary.newsContext: 来自新闻“Xi Story: Bringing Hainan's rainforest back to life”。

vocabulary.example: The speech inspires optimism for a new chapter in Asia-Pacific prosperity.
vocabulary.translation: 这篇演讲激发了人们对亚太繁荣新篇章的乐观期待。
vocabulary.newsContext: 来自新闻“Xi's APEC speech inspires optimism for new chapter in Asia-Pacific prosperity”。

vocabulary.example: Shared education and skills training are the roots of long-term prosperity.
vocabulary.translation: 共享的教育与技能培训是长期繁荣的根基。
vocabulary.newsContext: 来自新闻“a new chapter in Asia-Pacific prosperity”。

vocabulary.example: Xi was hailed for his bold vision on APEC progress.
vocabulary.translation: 习近平因对APEC发展的宏大愿景而受到赞誉。
vocabulary.newsContext: 来自新闻“Xi hailed for bold vision on APEC progress”。

pattern.pattern: not quite as + 形容词 + as ...（不如……那么……）
pattern.example: Not quite as smooth as silk, but the young learners are making steady progress.
pattern.translation: 虽然不像丝绸那样顺滑，但这些年轻学习者正在稳步进步。
pattern.usage: 用于委婉地表达“不如……那么……”，语气比直接用 not as...as 更柔和，常用于评价、对比表现或成果。

grammar.title: 过去分词作后置定语（Past Participle as Postpositive Modifier）
grammar.explanation: 过去分词（短语）放在名词后面作定语，相当于一个省略的定语从句，表示被动或已完成的动作。例如 a tax collected at home 相当于 a tax that is collected at home。这种结构在新闻英语中非常常见，能让句子更紧凑。
examples: A tariff intended to exert pressure abroad is still a tax collected at home.
The honor awarded on Saturday was dedicated to those who helped mold her career.

pronunciation.tips: 重音在第二个音节 /ˈzɪl/ 上，注意 /rɪ/ 要轻读；中间的 /ziːl/ 不要读成 /saɪl/，结尾 /iəns/ 连读为“伊恩斯”，整体节奏为 rɪ-ZIL-yəns。
examples: China's resilience has drawn wide attention from economists.
Resilience is a quality that education should help young people develop.

reading.title: From the Court to the Podium: What Lang Ping Teaches Us About Growth
reading.content:
On Saturday, China's volleyball legend Lang Ping received the Volleyball Order, the highest honor in the sport. The 65-year-old coach and former player did not keep the credit for herself. Instead, she dedicated the award to the teachers, teammates and coaches who helped mold her remarkable career.

Her story is a quiet lesson in growth. Talent may open a door, but it is patience, hard work and the willingness to learn from failure that keep it open. Lang Ping's journey also reminds us that success is rarely a solo achievement; it is built on the support and guidance of others.

For young learners, the message is simple: stay curious, accept correction, and honor the people who guide you. Growth is not a single moment of victory. It is the daily habit of becoming a little better than you were yesterday.
reading.translation:
周六，中国排球传奇郎平获得“排球勋章”——这项运动的最高荣誉。这位65岁的教练兼前运动员没有把功劳留给自己，而是将这份荣誉献给了那些帮助塑造她非凡职业生涯的老师、队友和教练。

她的故事是一堂关于成长的无声课。天赋也许能打开一扇门，但让这扇门一直敞开的，是耐心、努力以及从失败中学习的意愿。郎平的经历也提醒我们：成功很少是独自取得的，它建立在他人的支持与引导之上。

对年轻学习者而言，道理很简单：保持好奇，接受指正，并尊重那些引导你的人。成长不是某个胜利的瞬间，而是每天比昨天进步一点点的习惯。
reading.sourceNote: 素材来源：ChinaDaily 报道《Chinese star Lang Ping gets volleyball's highest honor》，并围绕“教育与成长”主题进行改写与拓展。
